stage: Before any counterfactual tests; original protocol and sample hashes retained
seed_correction: The implementation uses largest diff-line count among AST-changing Python files, not AST-node count. Keep the already frozen seeds, rather than selecting a new primary component after inspection.
production_scope_correction: Python-only component counting omits prompt YAML and CSS changes. Replay every changed file under src/minisweagent, including YAML and CSS, at its existing directory boundary. Report this amendment and the original Python-only component counts separately. No selected commits are added or dropped.
fixed_interface_sensitivity: In addition to original runtime={agents,models,environments,core}, support={run,config,utils}, evaluate a stronger fixed grouping with runtime={agents,models,environments,core,config} and support={run,utils}. Prompt/config producers and model consumers plausibly belong in one fixed unit. Registered before test outcomes.
adaptive_implementation: Source-only dependency closure: build an undirected graph from minisweagent imports in changed Python files and literal identifiers they reference, resolved to definitions in those files. Top-level Model, Agent, Environment protocols map to models, agents, environments. For changed non-Python templates, identical identifier tokens in changed Python source add an edge. Starting from the frozen seed, take the connected component. This uses known edit locations (oracle localization) but not test outcomes. It is a deliberately simple adaptive-scope proxy, NOT a learned organizer or actual improver experiment.
artifact_test_safety: Use a dedicated WSL virtual environment and fresh variant trees. Strip inherited environment down to an allowlist. Do not run fire tests or Docker tests. Keep upstream test code unchanged. A Python audit hook blocks external socket connections inside the test interpreter; this is defense in depth, not a filesystem/OS sandbox. Reviewed subprocess commands execute only local fixtures.
causality: Suite-level conjunction (different tests need different fixes) does not establish a synergistic single behavior. Identify individual test cases that only the joint variant passes; keep mock-driven regression tests distinct from live solver scores.
